description: Curated evaluation benchmark for the 3GPP RAG chatbot (SRD §44). This is a starter set covering every required category; scale to 100-150 questions once the full 8-document corpus is ingested (SRD recommends 100-150).

questions.query: What is the role of the AMF in the 5G System architecture?
What is the function of the UPF in the 5G core network?
What does the SMF do in a PDU session?
What are the steps of the registration procedure in 5GS?
How is a PDU session established?
What is timer T3510 and when is it started?
What NAS message does the UE send to initiate registration?
What is contained in an RRCReconfiguration message?
What triggers an RRC connection re-establishment?
How is mutual authentication performed between the UE and the network in 5G?
What key hierarchy is used for 5G security?
What is the default value of timer T3502?
What does the 5QI parameter represent?
What are the standardized 5QI values and their corresponding resource types?
What are the possible 5GMM cause values and their meanings?
How does the registration procedure described in 23.502 relate to the NAS registration request in 24.501?
How does the PDU session establishment procedure in 23.502 relate to PFCP session establishment in 29.244?
What was the internal budget allocated by 3GPP for developing Release 18?
Which specific engineers at Ericsson authored TS 24.501?
What is the exact silicon die size of a commercial 5G modem chipset?
In Release 17, what changes were introduced to NR-U channel access?
questions.note: Corpus is Rel-18 only; a Rel-17-specific question must abstain even if related Rel-18 content exists.

questions.query: What was new in TS 23.501 Release 15 compared to Release 14?
